senses.sense_definition: A red and painful condition of the skin caused by overexposure to ultraviolet rays from the sun.

examples.text: She applied soothing aloe vera gel to relieve the painful <w>sunburn</w> on her shoulders.
Wearing sunscreen can prevent a bad <w>sunburn</w> while you are outdoors.

senses.sense_definition: A browning of the skin from exposure to the sun; a suntan.

examples.text: The neutral colours showed off her rich golden <w>sunburn</w> after the beach trip.
After weeks working outside, he had acquired a deep <w>sunburn</w> that lasted all summer.

traits.comment: Often used where 'tan' or 'suntan' is preferred in modern usage.

senses.sense_definition: Damage or discoloration on the surface of plants or fruits caused by excessive sunlight.

examples.text: Strong afternoon heat caused severe <w>sunburn</w> on the ripening tomatoes.
Shade nets are widely used to protect delicate crops from <w>sunburn</w>.

senses.sense_definition: To suffer damage or redness to the skin from overexposure to sunlight.

examples.text: People with fair skin easily <w>sunburn</w> without protective lotion.
He forgot his wide hat and began to <w>sunburn</w> after only an hour on the boat.

senses.sense_definition: To cause someone's skin or body part to become burned or damaged by the sun.

examples.text: Spending all afternoon on the open lake had <w>sunburned</w> his unprotected neck and arms.
Be careful not to <w>sunburn</w> your face while hiking in the mountains.

senses.sense_definition: The fictional romantic pairing of characters Sunny and Aubrey from the videogame Omori.

examples.text: Many fans of the indie role-playing game enthusiastically create fan art depicting <w>Sunburn</w>.
In online discussions about the game, supporters of <w>Sunburn</w> debated the relationship dynamic between the two protagonists.
